rescueTop10.event: Upbringing in Alexandria & Ptolemy XII Auletes’ Debt
rescueTop10.significance: Ptolemaic dynastic strife, Gabinius’ 55 BC Roman restoration of Auletes, and Cleopatra’s nine-language education.

rescueTop10.event: Joint Accession, Civil War with Ptolemy XIII & Pompey’s Murder
rescueTop10.significance: Driven out by Pothinus/Achillas; Pompey murdered on Pelusium beach (48 BC).

rescueTop10.event: Alexandrian War, Julius Caesar & Birth of Caesarion
rescueTop10.significance: Cleopatra smuggled to Caesar (Plutarch Caesar 48–49); Ptolemy XIII drowns; Nile cruise and birth of Ptolemy XV Caesarion.

rescueTop10.event: Cleopatra in Rome & Ides of March
rescueTop10.significance: Stays at Caesar’s Tiber villa, golden Venus Genetrix statue (Suetonius/Cicero), returns to Alexandria after Caesar’s assassination.

rescueTop10.event: Golden Barge Meeting with Mark Antony at Tarsus
rescueTop10.significance: Sails up River Cydnus dressed as Aphrodite/Venus meeting Dionysus (Plutarch Antony 25–27), securing removal of Arsinoe IV.
Antony restores Cyprus, Cilicia, and Phoenician cedar coasts to Egypt to fund warships and grain.
Caesarion named King of Kings and joint ruler with Cleopatra; Alexander Helios, Cleopatra Selene, and Ptolemy Philadelphus given eastern realms.

rescueTop10.event: Divorce of Octavia, Seized Will & Senate War on Cleopatra
rescueTop10.significance: Octavian reads Antony’s will in Rome and declares war on foreign Queen Cleopatra rather than Roman citizens.
Agrippa blockades Ambracian Gulf; Cleopatra’s 60 Egyptian ships break out with treasury followed by Antony (Plutarch, Dio, Velleius, Virgil).

rescueTop10.event: Fall of Alexandria & Suicide of Antony and Cleopatra
rescueTop10.significance: Antony dies in Cleopatra’s mausoleum; Cleopatra chooses royal suicide to evade Octavian’s Roman triumph (Horace Odes 1.37; Plutarch 77–86).
